brief:
Israel's Shin Bet security agency said it arrested a cell from Nablus that planned to assassinate National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir using an explosive drone, the Ma'an Wire reported. The agency alleged the group also plotted to kidnap a soldier.

Details of the alleged plot, including the timing or operational stage of the plan, were not disclosed in the Shin Bet's statement.
title: Israeli Security Agency Claims It Arrests Nablus Cell Planning Ben-Gvir Assassination
